summary: 3 charges: write a magical message on an object by playing.
text: This musical instrument has 3 charges. While you are playing it, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 charge and write a magical message on a nonmagical object or surface you can see within 30 feet of you. (No other effect in the game.)
